locations.name: Ooni's Palace
locations.description: The historic palace of the Ooni of Ife, the spiritual leader of the Yoruba people. A center of cultural and traditional significance.

locations.name: White House at the Palace
locations.description: An iconic white colonial-style building within the palace complex used for official functions.

locations.name: Geru Hall at the Palace
locations.description: A significant hall within the palace complex used for meetings and royal ceremonies.

locations.name: Museum of Antiquities
locations.description: A museum housing ancient artifacts and preserving the history of Ile-Ife for generations.

locations.name: Postherds at the Museum
locations.description: A traditional structure within the museum grounds historically used for the care of royal livestock.

locations.name: Adire Shop
locations.description: A shop showcasing traditional Adire cloth weaving and dyeing in Ile-Ife.

locations.name: Ogun Laadin
locations.description: Sacred shrine dedicated to the Yoruba deity Ogun, the god of iron and war.

locations.name: Kensington Adebutu Hall
locations.description: A modern community hall at Enuwa Square used for cultural performances and public events.

locations.name: Palace Chalets
locations.description: Guest chalets associated with the palace grounds, available with limited access.

locations.name: Oduduwa Statue at OAU
locations.description: A guardian statue of Oduduwa, the progenitor of the Yoruba race, standing prominently at Obafemi Awolowo University's campus.

locations.name: Ife Native Authority Offices
locations.description: Historic administrative offices of the Ife local government authority.

locations.name: The Independence Tower
locations.description: A prominent tower built to mark Nigerian independence, a key Ile-Ife landmark.

locations.name: The Central Mosque
locations.description: A prominent mosque in Ile-Ife, known for its unique architecture.

locations.name: Yeyemolu Ancient Wall
locations.description: An ancient wall with historical significance, located in Ile-Ife.

locations.name: Okoro Compound (Court of Laws of Ife)
locations.description: A prominent court complex with historical significance, located in Ile-Ife.

locations.name: Oke Mogun Shrine
locations.description: A significant religious site with historical importance, located in Ile-Ife.

locations.name: St. Paul's Cathedral, Ayegbaju
locations.description: A historic cathedral with architectural significance, located in Ayegbaju.
